docker_compose_file:
services:
  alpha-kms:
    image: ghcr.io/alphacompute/alpha-kms@sha256:6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b6b
    environment:
      ALPHACOMPUTE_DATABASE_URL: ${ALPHACOMPUTE_DATABASE_URL}
      ALPHACOMPUTE_KMS_ENDPOINTS: ${ALPHACOMPUTE_KMS_ENDPOINTS}
      ALPHACOMPUTE_PCCS_URL: ${ALPHACOMPUTE_PCCS_URL}
      ALPHACOMPUTE_PLATFORM_DOCUMENT_URL: ${ALPHACOMPUTE_PLATFORM_DOCUMENT_URL}
    ports:
    - 8443:8443
    restart: always
    volumes:
    - /sys/kernel/config:/sys/kernel/config
    - /run/log/dstack:/run/log/dstack:ro
    - /sys/firmware/acpi/tables/data/CCEL:/ccel:ro
name: 01994c2e-0000-7000-8000-000000000006
pre_launch_script: if [ -n "${ALPHACOMPUTE_GHCR_TOKEN:-}" ]; then printf '%s' "$ALPHACOMPUTE_GHCR_TOKEN" | docker login ghcr.io -u x-access-token --password-stdin; fi
